left.description: Left-arm recovery strategy: previous returns to the latest safely reached measured joint checkpoint from a successful non-recovery pose action, or the initialized checkpoint if none has completed; home uses the source-bound RoboTwin start joints. Failed actions and recovery actions do not replace previous. Neither changes its gripper command.

right.description: Right-arm recovery strategy: previous returns to the latest safely reached measured joint checkpoint from a successful non-recovery pose action, or the initialized checkpoint if none has completed; home uses the source-bound RoboTwin start joints. Failed actions and recovery actions do not replace previous. Neither changes its gripper command.

targets.description: Non-empty sparse planner-backed robot recovery routes. Omitted arms receive no planner or drive target. This never resets the episode, objects or evaluator state.
